title: how to use the plain text editor for emails

Marketing • Emails • Templates
How to Use the Plain Text Editor for Emails
The Plain Text Editor lets you create simple, text-focused emails without building a visual layout. Use it when your message should prioritize written content over design-heavy elements.

What You'll Learn
Learn what the Plain Text Editor is, when to use it, how to create a plain-text email template, and how it differs from other email editing options.

Table of Contents

1
What Is the Plain Text Editor?
The Plain Text Editor is one of HighLevel's email editing options for creating simple, text-focused messages. It is useful when you want the email to feel more like a direct message and do not need the visual layouts available in the Design Editor.

2
When to Use the Plain Text Editor
The Plain Text Editor is useful when the message should focus primarily on written content rather than a designed layout.
Common examples include:
Direct or conversational messages
Welcome or follow-up emails
Text-heavy communications
Emails that do not require complex layouts or visual design

3
How to Create a Plain Text Email Template
Create a new template and select the Plain Text Editor when you want a text-focused email instead of a drag-and-drop design or custom HTML.
Go to Marketing → Emails → Templates.
Click + New.
 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082344619/original/ohFFJjc34NvOYOakWvCvQDJMyghtWbJgCw.png?1790924171] 

Choose to create a new email template from scratch.
When the editor options appear, select Plain Text.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082345273/original/vhuNKgYwYPYz-Y0rEtllpYa2tYk7iIX_kA.png?1790924754] 
Enter your email content.
Review the email before using it in a campaign or automation.
Click Save Template.
 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082344819/original/9WhXViRnyoH3gCuTA2gDp9wzwTDgzCorWw.png?1790924423] 

4
Plain Text vs. Other Email Editors
HighLevel provides different editing options depending on how you want to build the email.

Plain Text
Use for simple, text-focused messages that do not require a designed layout.

Design Editor
Use for visual emails built with drag-and-drop elements and designed layouts.

Code Editor
Use when the email requires direct HTML control.

Note: Plain Text is not the same as Quick Compose. Quick Compose is a separate lightweight email creation option, while Plain Text is an editor option available through Smart Builder.

5
Preview and Test the Email
Review the email before using the template in a live campaign. HighLevel provides Preview and Test Email tools for email campaigns and templates so you can check content, personalization, and inbox rendering before sending.

For detailed testing instructions, see  [https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001215382-preview-and-test-your-email-campaigns-templates] Preview and Test Your Email Campaigns/Templates.

6
Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is the Plain Text Editor still available in HighLevel?
Yes. Plain Text remains one of the editor options available through HighLevel's Smart Builder.

Q: Is Plain Text the same as Quick Compose?
No. HighLevel documents Quick Compose as a separate lightweight email creation option. Plain Text is an editor option available through Smart Builder.

Q: Can I use the Plain Text Editor in workflows?
Yes. Workflow Send Email actions support Smart Builder → Plain Text.

Q: When should I use the Design Editor instead?
Use the Design Editor when the email needs visual layouts or drag-and-drop elements such as images, buttons, columns, or other designed content.
